verses.original: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּרָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·māh Yah·weh ta·‘ă·mōḏ bə·rā·ḥō·wq ta‘·lîm lə·‘it·tō·wṯ baṣ·ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: Why O LORD do You stand far off Why do You hide in times of trouble

verses.original: בְּגַאֲוַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע יִדְלַ֣ק עָנִ֑י יִתָּפְשׂ֓וּ׀ בִּמְזִמּ֖וֹת ז֣וּ חָשָֽׁבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḡa·’ă·waṯ rā·šā‘ yiḏ·laq ‘ā·nî yit·tā·p̄ə·śū bim·zim·mō·wṯ zū ḥā·šā·ḇū
verses.literal: In pride the wicked pursue the needy let them be caught in the schemes . . . they devise

verses.original: כִּֽי־ רָ֭שָׁע הִלֵּ֣ל עַל־ תַּאֲוַ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ בֵּ֝רֵ֗ךְ וּבֹצֵ֥עַ נִ֘אֵ֥ץ׀ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- rā·šā‘ hil·lêl ‘al- ta·’ă·waṯ nap̄·šōw bê·rêḵ ū·ḇō·ṣê·a‘ ni·’êṣ Yah·weh
verses.literal: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD

verses.original: כְּגֹ֣בַהּ אַ֭פּוֹ רָשָׁ֗ע בַּל־ יִדְרֹ֑שׁ כָּל־ מְזִמּוֹתָֽיו׃ אֵ֥ין אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: kə·ḡō·ḇah ’ap·pōw rā·šā‘ bal- yiḏ·rōš kāl- mə·zim·mō·w·ṯāw ’ên ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: In his pride . . . the wicked [man] does not seek [Him] in all his schemes there is no God

verses.original: יָ֘חִ֤ילוּ דַרְכּוֹ בְּכָל־ עֵ֗ת מָר֣וֹם מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּ֑וֹ יָפִ֥יחַ בָּהֶֽם׃ כָּל־ צ֝וֹרְרָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: yā·ḥî·lū ḏar·kō bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ mā·rō·wm miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā min·neḡ·dōw yā·p̄î·aḥ bā·hem kāl- ṣō·wr·rāw
verses.literal: He is secure in his ways at all times . . . Your lofty judgments are far from him he sneers at all his foes

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ בַּל־ אֶמּ֑וֹט לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ בְרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar bə·lib·bōw bal- ’em·mō·wṭ lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr ’ă·šer lō- ḇə·rā‘
verses.literal: He says to himself I will not be moved from age to age - I am free of distress

verses.original: פִּ֣יהוּ מָ֭לֵא אָלָ֤ה וּמִרְמ֣וֹת וָתֹ֑ךְ עָמָ֥ל וָאָֽוֶן׃ תַּ֥חַת לְ֝שׁוֹנ֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: pî·hū mā·lê ’ā·lāh ū·mir·mō·wṯ wā·ṯōḵ ‘ā·māl wā·’ā·wen ta·ḥaṯ lə·šō·w·nōw
verses.literal: His mouth is full of cursing deceit and violence trouble and malice are under his tongue

verses.original: יֵשֵׁ֤ב׀ בְּמַאְרַ֬ב חֲצֵרִ֗ים בַּֽ֭מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗יו יִצְפֹּֽנוּ׃ לְֽחֵלְכָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: yê·šêḇ bə·ma’·raḇ ḥă·ṣê·rîm bam·mis·tā·rîm ya·hă·rōḡ nā·qî ‘ê·nāw yiṣ·pō·nū lə·ḥê·lə·ḵāh
verses.literal: He lies in wait near the villages in ambush he slays the innocent his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless

verses.original: יֶאֱרֹ֬ב בַּמִּסְתָּ֨ר׀ כְּאַרְיֵ֬ה בְסֻכֹּ֗ה יֶ֭אֱרֹב לַחֲט֣וֹף עָנִ֑י יַחְטֹ֥ף עָ֝נִ֗י בְּמָשְׁכ֥וֹ בְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ye·’ĕ·rōḇ bam·mis·tār kə·’ar·yêh ḇə·suk·kōh ye·’ĕ·rōḇ la·ḥă·ṭō·wp̄ ‘ā·nî yaḥ·ṭōp̄ ‘ā·nî bə·mā·šə·ḵōw ḇə·riš·tōw
verses.literal: He lies in wait . . . like a lion in a thicket he lurks to seize the oppressed he catches the lowly in his net . . .
They are crushed and beaten down the helpless fall prey to his strength

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֑ל שָׁ֣כַֽח הִסְתִּ֥יר פָּ֝נָ֗יו בַּל־ לָנֶֽצַח׃ רָאָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar bə·lib·bōw ’êl šā·ḵaḥ his·tîr pā·nāw bal- lā·ne·ṣaḥ rā·’āh
verses.literal: He says to himself God has forgotten He hides His face and never . . . sees

verses.original: קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה נְשָׂ֣א יָדֶ֑ךָ אֵ֭ל אַל־ תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח עֲנִיִּים׃
verses.transliteration: qū·māh Yah·weh nə·śā yā·ḏe·ḵā ’êl ’al- tiš·kaḥ ʿă·nī·yīm
verses.literal: Arise O LORD Lift up Your hand O God Do not forget the helpless

verses.original: עַל־ מֶ֤ה׀ רָשָׁ֥ע׀ נִאֵ֖ץ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָמַ֥ר בְּ֝לִבּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִּדְרֹֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- meh rā·šā‘ ni·’êṣ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ā·mar bə·lib·bōw lō tiḏ·rōš
verses.literal: Why . . . has the wicked man renounced God He says to himself You will never call [me] to account

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֤ה׀ רָאִ֡תָה עָ֘מָ֤ל וָכַ֨עַס׀ תַּבִּיט֮ לָתֵ֪ת בְּיָ֫דֶ֥ךָ חֵלֶ֑כָה יַעֲזֹ֣ב עָ֭לֶיךָ אַתָּ֤ה׀ הָיִ֬יתָ עוֹזֵֽר׃ יָ֝ת֗וֹם
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh rā·’i·ṯāh ‘ā·māl wā·ḵa·‘as tab·bîṭ lā·ṯêṯ bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā ḥê·le·ḵāh ya·‘ă·zōḇ ‘ā·le·ḵā ’at·tāh hā·yî·ṯā ‘ō·w·zêr yā·ṯō·wm
verses.literal: But You have regarded trouble and grief You see to repay [it] by Your hand The victim entrusts himself to You You are the helper of the fatherless

verses.original: שְׁ֭בֹר זְר֣וֹעַ רָשָׁ֑ע וָ֝רָ֗ע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ־ רִשְׁע֥וֹ בַל־ תִּמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: šə·b̲ōr zə·rō·w·a‘ rā·šā‘ wā·rā‘ tiḏ·rō·wōš- riš·‘ōw ḇal- tim·ṣā
verses.literal: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מֶ֭לֶךְ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ג֝וֹיִ֗ם אָבְד֥וּ מֵֽאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: The LORD is King forever and ever the nations perish from His land

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה תַּאֲוַ֬ת עֲנָוִ֣ים תָּכִ֥ין לִ֝בָּ֗ם תַּקְשִׁ֥יב אָזְנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tā Yah·weh ta·’ă·waṯ ‘ă·nā·wîm tā·ḵîn lib·bām taq·šîḇ ’ā·zə·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: You have heard O LORD the desire of the humble You will strengthen their hearts You will incline Your ear

verses.original: לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יָת֗וֹם וָ֫דָ֥ךְ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ לַעֲרֹ֥ץ בַּל־ יוֹסִ֥יף ע֑וֹד
verses.transliteration: liš·pōṭ yā·ṯō·wm wā·ḏāḵ ’ĕ·nō·wōš min- hā·’ā·reṣ la·‘ă·rōṣ bal- yō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed that the men of the earth may strike terror no more . . . . . .
